observations.claim: Production agent infrastructure is converging on unified execution, memory, retrieval and governance control planes.
verifiedFacts: MongoDB launched Atlas Agent Engine as a unified execution, memory, retrieval and governance layer.
MongoDB states actions are logged against identity and governed by policy.
It supports model/framework/cloud neutrality with MCP and A2A.
inference: Verified: governance and state are core agent infrastructure.
Inferred: the commercial boundary is the governed context/execution layer.
Unknown: whether buyers will pay for vendor-neutral governance.
observations.significance: Refines Seed Loom toward governed context, identity, memory and execution.
assumptions: Vendor-neutral evidence remains valuable beside native controls.

observations.claim: Enterprise conversational voice agents are being positioned as organizational interfaces connected to knowledge and systems.
verifiedFacts: ElevenLabs announced a $300M employee tender valuing it at $22B.
ElevenLabs released v4 and v4 Turbo.
It describes agents connected to organizational knowledge and systems.
inference: Verified: voice is being packaged as an organizational interaction platform.
Inferred: multimodal knowledge access could become a bounded service.
Unknown: whether voice improves outcomes over text.
observations.significance: Reinforces Eve as a multimodal interface experiment.
assumptions: Voice lowers friction for some knowledge tasks.
knownLimitations: Tender is secondary liquidity, not a primary raise.

observations.claim: AI infrastructure funding is reaching optical interconnects aimed at the memory-bandwidth bottleneck.
verifiedFacts: Volantis is developing VCSEL optical interconnects for AI memory.
Reuters reported a target of up to 220 memory chips around a GPU.
inference: Verified: investors are funding physical-layer AI infrastructure.
Inferred: optical and wave engineering broadens the demonstration vocabulary.
Unknown: commercial readiness and customer commitments.
observations.significance: Expands the technical thesis toward physical signal paths.
assumptions: Small systems demonstrations can extract useful physical-infrastructure lessons.

observations.claim: MIT Future Fest is demonstrating translation of molecular structure and vibration into spatial sound, imagery and embodied XR interaction.
verifiedFacts: It uses a caddisfly silk-protein model and vibrational behavior.
Collaborators span molecular modeling, sound, XR and biotech.
inference: Verified: science, sonification, XR and ecological material context are combined.
Inferred: this is a strong science-to-experience precedent.
Unknown: whether it improves learning or repeatable commercial demand.
observations.significance: Strongly reinforces the governed visual/compiler thesis.
assumptions: Rigorously sourced scientific data can support defensible interactive translation.
knownLimitations: Public art/research precedent, not market validation.

observations.claim: Professional building-technology programming is coupling engineered living materials, adaptive facades and robotic construction.
verifiedFacts: CMU lists engineered living materials for adaptive facades.
The program also included robotic construction and climate/building science.
The congress convened professionals, academics and industry participants.
inference: Verified: living materials and robotic fabrication are active professional research topics.
Inferred: this supports regenerative fabrication demonstrations.
Unknown: code acceptance, durability, procurement and lifecycle economics.
assumptions: Computational fabrication demos can communicate value before deployment readiness.
knownLimitations: Event participation is not procurement evidence.
